identity.description: An attacker initiates an RDP session from an uncommon source IP to a target host, then uses stolen credentials to execute commands remotely. Cortex should detect the abnormal RDP session and subsequent process behavior.

payload.code:
net use \\192.0.2.5\C$ /user:Administrator
rundll32.exe advpack.dll,RunSetupSrv
psexec.exe \\192.0.2.5 -u Administrator -p password123 cmd.exe

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Abnormal RDP Session
biocs.description: RDP session initiated from a rarely seen host to a target
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION_ESTABLISHED
| filter dst_port = 3389
| comp count() as events by agent_hostname, agent_hostname
| sort desc events

abiocs.name: RDP Session with Remote Execution
abiocs.description: Detection of RDP session followed by execution of remote command
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION_ESTABLISHED
| filter dst_port = 3389
| join with (dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'psexec.exe') on causality_actor_process_image_name = action_process_image_name
| filter event_time_diff < 300

xql_queries.name: Detect Rare Host RDP Sessions
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION_ESTABLISHED
| filter dst_port = 3389
| comp count() by action_remote_ip, dst_ip
